content.value: Consider a long hollow cylinder of inside radius $r = a$ and outside radius $r = b .$ The outer surface is heated uniformly at a constant rate of ${ \mathfrak { q } } _ { 0 } \ { \mathrm { W / m } } ^ { 2 }$ while the inner surface is maintained at zero temperature. Develop an expression for the steady -- state temperature distribution T(r) in the cylinder.
